verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs mention general payroll scheduling flexibility ('Run payroll on your schedule... process payroll as often as you need') and customizable pay types, but there is no explicit documentation confirming support for concurrent weekly/biweekly/semimonthly/monthly schedules segmented by team. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple simultaneous pay schedules, per-team/per-group schedule assignment, and any hands-on confirmation of this specific setup.
